company.text: Vox Media is a US digital media company whose brands include Vox, The Verge, New York Magazine, The Cut, Vulture, Eater and Polygon, plus a large podcast network. **Vox Creative**, its in-house creative services division, produces branded content for advertisers across those brands. In 2026 the group went through **ownership and strategy changes** linked to **James Murdoch's Lupa Systems**, including a small restructuring in August 2026; at the same time Vox posted new creative and experiential roles (Associate Director Experiential, Executive Creative Director, Creative Services Manager).

financials.text: Private company: no audited figures published. Repeated rounds of cost cutting (2023–2026) show **budget pressure**, so the pitch must show **commercial value** (winning or keeping advertisers), not only compliance.

history.text: LinkedIn (as Charles). Josh replied: he loves the sound of what Flying Secoya does and is happy to chat; there is **a lot of change at the company**, nothing impactful **before next year**; email him at **josh.levine@voxmedia.com**. industry.title: Ad industry carbon measurement
industry.text: Agencies and publishers are adopting carbon measurement for ad production (e.g. AdGreen in the UK, Ad Net Zero). US brands follow through their global ESG reporting.

industry.title: Branded content budgets under scrutiny
industry.text: Media groups cut costs but keep investing in high-value branded and experiential work, where differentiation matters.

industry.title: Ownership changes reset priorities
industry.text: New owners usually review vendors and processes: a good moment to be in the 2027 plan.

talking_points: Do Vox Creative's advertisers already ask about the **carbon footprint or sustainability** of their campaigns? Which categories (auto, tech, finance)?
How are productions run today: in-house crews, external production companies, or both? Where would measurement be easiest?
Would a **pilot on 1–2 campaigns in Q1–Q2 2027**, with a 'responsible production' label for the advertiser, be useful?
Who else should be in the call: **Head of Branded Content**, sales/partnerships, or the experiential team?
When is the **2027 budget** decided, so the pilot can be included?

attention.title: Don't push for now.
